title: Drilling
description: Parameters of a 'drill' operation (cam.h Operation::paramsJson, task T-035): spot drilling, drilling, peck drilling, chip breaking, tapping, boring and reaming as canned cycles, one hole per cycle move. The operation's geometry is a face of each hole to machine. Its heights are measured from each hole's own top: 'retract' is the R plane (where the feed starts and where G99 returns), 'top' moves the hole top, 'clearance' is the initial level (G98) measured from the highest hole top; 'feedPlane' and 'bottom' are not used. The feed into the hole is the cutting feed (Operation cutting feedCut); a tap's feed is its pitch times the spindle speed. Lengths are millimetres, times seconds. Annotations for editors: 'x-unit' (length, time, count), 'x-enumTitles' (labels of an enum, in order), 'x-enumDescriptions' (a detail line for each enum value, such as its G codes),'x-relevantWhen' (the property matters only when every named property has one of the listed values), 'x-propertyOrder' (the order of the form), 'x-heightsUsed' and 'x-cuttingUsed' (the members of the operation's heights and cutting data this type reads), 'x-geometry' (what the geometry picker selects: here holes) and 'x-toolTypes' (the tools the picker offers for each cycle); docs/operation_types.md defines each.

x-geometry.description: Click any face of each hole to machine.

cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.description: What the tool does in each hole.
x-enumDescriptions: G81 to the spot diameter; G82 with a dwell
G83: full retract after each peck
G73: a short back-off after each peck
G85, feed in and out; G89 with a dwell
G85, feed in and out; G89 with a dwell

depthFrom.title: Depth from
depthFrom.description: 'hole': the depth the model gives each hole (through holes break through, blind holes go to their bottom, a spot to its chamfer diameter, a tap to the thread depth). 'value': the depth below each hole's top given here.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Depth below the hole top: of the full diameter or of the tip (Depth reference).

depthReference.title: Depth reference
depthReference.description: 'fullDiameter': the depth is where the tool reaches its full diameter, so the tip goes deeper by the length of its point. 'tip': the depth of the tool tip.

breakthrough.title: Breakthrough
breakthrough.description: Through holes: how far past the exit the full diameter goes (the tip goes further by the length of its point; a tap's lead is added too).

allowBelowFloor.title: Drill point below a flat floor
allowBelowFloor.description: Blind holes with a flat floor: off, the tip stops at the floor (the floor is left with a drill point); on, the full diameter reaches the floor and the tip goes below it.

spotDiameter.title: Spot diameter
spotDiameter.description: Diameter of the spot at the hole top; 0: the hole's chamfer or countersink diameter, else its drilled diameter.

peck.title: Peck depth
peck.description: Depth of each peck (Q), the first one measured from the R plane; 0: no pecking, the hole is drilled in one feed (G81).

peckClearance.title: Peck clearance
peckClearance.description: Re-entry clearance above the last depth (G83) or back-off (G73); 0: the control's own setting.

tapLeadPitches.title: Tap lead
tapLeadPitches.description: Taps: how many pitches the tap tip goes beyond the full-thread depth (the tap's chamfer, e.g. 2 for a plug tap). Not added when the hole gives no thread depth: the tap then goes to the drilled depth.

leftHand.title: Left-hand thread
leftHand.description: Taps: tap left-hand (G74) holes that have no thread spec, such as those of an imported part. A hole with a thread spec is tapped by its spec.

dwell.title: Dwell
dwell.description: Dwell at the bottom of each hole.

holeOrder.title: Hole order
holeOrder.description: 'shortest': the shortest path from the work origin; 'selection': the order the holes were picked.

allowOtherTools.title: Allow other tools
allowOtherTools.description: Let an end mill or another tool not made for the cycle do it (never a tap other than for tapping).
